'''Shell Hutt armor''' was the armor worn by the [[Shell Hutts]] of [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]]. It was made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and had built in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] that allowed the wearer to hover five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the ground.<ref name="LoNH" />
